Portfolio Download

            
Select one or more mutual funds and download their equity, debt, or complete portfolio — each stock with its sector, market cap, ISIN, and allocation in every selected fund. Blank cells mean the fund does not hold that stock. Data comes from the Mutual Fund Finder sheet.

Settings & Data

                  
Save Settings & Shareable File stores every Google Sheet link, sync interval, and configuration, and downloads a standalone copy of this dashboard with the latest synced data baked in.

Editable Stock Return Sheet

Replace the returns, paste a fresh list from Excel, or copy the current list out for editing.

Google Sheets Sync - Fund NAVs

Google Sheets Sync - Stock Prices Over Time

              
Paste a normal Google Sheets share link or a direct CSV export link. The sheet should include columns such as List (stock name), Ticker, Code (ISIN), Todays Price, Price 1 Months Ago, Price 3 Months Ago, Price 6 Months Ago, Price 1 Year Ago, Price 2 Year Ago, Price 3 Year Ago, Price 5 Year Ago, Price 10 Year Ago.

              

                
                
                
✅ Sheet linked  ...2nBKARwgEnDpZtV1mMQ/edit?usp=sharing

              

              

                

                  
                  
                  

                

                

                  
                  
                

              

              

                
                
              

              
Synced 754 stock price rows on 5/15/2026, 5:33:04 PM. Auto-sync runs every 1 minute(s).

            


            

              
Google Sheets Sync - Stock Finder

              
Paste a normal Google Sheets share link or a direct CSV export link. Keep the columns in this order: Company name, ISIN, BSE Symbol, NSE Symbol, MSEI Symbol, the three 6-month average market caps, Average of All Exchanges, and Categorization.

              

                
                
                

              

              

                
              

              

                

                  
                  
                

                

                  
                  
                

              

              

                
                
              

              
No Google Sheet linked yet for Stock Finder.

            


            

              
Google Sheets Sync - Mutual Fund Finder

              
Dedicated source for the Mutual Fund Finder section (independent of all other data). Keep the columns in this order: Fund Name, Stock Name, Stock Holding (%) in Fund, Stock Sector, Stock ISIN, Stock Market Cap. Cash is derived per fund as 100% − total stock allocation.
